settings.title: Do not sell or share my personal information
settings.intro: You can ask us not to sell or share your personal information, or to access or delete it.

settings.text: Nicshape does not sell your personal information for money. To make a privacy request, email info@nicshape.com with the subject “Privacy request” and tell us what you would like us to do. We may need to confirm your identity before acting on your request.
